title: A window ended by a non-queued fatal control disable may not be saved before a crash, and that branch has no test
outcome: When record_engram_transport_failure disables control and ends a head's prepared-begin window, the ended window is durably committed by that transition or by a guaranteed follow-up. A test drives a fatal reply through the non-queued path (a runtime-loss rebind, a delegation bind, or a post-reconfigure bind) and shows that after a restart nothing replays without Resume.
acceptance: A window that record_engram_transport_failure ends on a fatal disable is committed by the same transition, or by a guaranteed follow-up save (for example, the retry tick commits a window ended by a disable even when it did not end it itself). This holds even for a head with no retry record and for a head whose retry step returns Wait.
A test drives a fatal control_unavailable through a non-queued caller for a head in prepared-begin recovery, reloads from the store, and shows the window ended and no automatic replay until Resume.
